{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|The President of the Imperial Senate hereby requests all whom it may concern to permit the Galactic Citizen named herein to pass without delay or hinderance through all spaceports and star systems.|Opening statement|<ref name="The Star Wars Intergalactic Passport">''[[The Star Wars Intergalactic Passport]]''</ref>}}
The '''President of the Imperial Senate''' was a senior [[Politics/Legends|political]] official in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that was in charge of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]]. Prior to it [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolution]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the President of the Imperial Senate was in charge of authorizing citizens [[Intergalactic Passport|passports]] allowing them unhindered access throughout all [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] and [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].

==Behind the scenes==
The '''President of the Imperial Senate''' was a title mentioned in the opening statement in ''[[The Star Wars Intergalactic Passport]]''. It is unclear whether the title had any relation to the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]], who at least officially had been advised by the Imperial Senate.
